# U.S. Dictionary

> A comprehensive online dictionary providing definitions, etymologies, and usage examples for American English words, idioms, and phrases.

U.S. Dictionary is maintained by Shaun Connell and Ariana Kumpf and serves as a reference resource for understanding word meanings, idiom origins, and vocabulary in the context of American English. The site combines traditional dictionary entries with modern terminology and cultural references.

## Key Topics

- Word definitions
- Idiom definitions
- Etymology
- American English
- Pronunciation guide
- Phrase meanings
- Vocabulary
- Dictionary entries
- Synonyms
- Parts of speech
- Idiom origin
- English language
- Word meanings
- Cultural terminology
- Internet slang

## Core Reference

- [U.S. Dictionary: Meaning and Definitions of Words and Idioms](https://usdictionary.com): U.S. Dictionary homepage with comprehensive word definitions and idioms
- [Definitions - US Dictionary](https://usdictionary.com/definitions): Main definitions glossary and word meanings reference resource
- [Idioms - US Dictionary](https://usdictionary.com/idioms): Main idioms and English phrases reference collection

## Word Definitions

- [Zeitgeist: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/zeitgeist): Definition and etymology of Zeitgeist with cultural analysis
- [Demo: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/demo): Definition and origin of Demo with pronunciation and synonyms
- [Pro-life: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/pro-life): Definition of Pro-life political term with social context
- [Bundle: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/bundle): Definition and evolution of Bundle as package and marketing tactic
- [Freelancer: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/freelancer): Definition of Freelancer with self-employment career context
- [Golden Plateau: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/golden-plateau): Golden Plateau definition with AI and economics terminology
- [Industrial: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/industrial): Definition of Industrial term with manufacturing context
- [Cm: Definition, Meaning, and Examples](https://usdictionary.com/definitions/cm): Abbreviation definition for CM (centimeter) in metric system

## Idioms & Phrases

- [Rub Shoulders: Definition, Meaning, and Origin](https://usdictionary.com/idioms/rub-shoulders): Idiom definition for "rub shoulders" with networking context
- [In the Loop: Definition, Meaning, and Origin](https://usdictionary.com/idioms/in-the-loop): Idiom definition for "in the loop" in business communication
- [Rickroll: Definition, Meaning, and Origin](https://usdictionary.com/idioms/rickroll): Rickroll internet meme definition featuring Rick Astley origin
- [Rile Me Up: Definition, Meaning, and Origin](https://usdictionary.com/idioms/rile-me-up): Idiom definition for "rile me up" expressing emotional disturbance
- [Don't Get Me Wrong: Definition, Meaning, and Origin](https://usdictionary.com/idioms/dont-get-me-wrong): Idiom definition for "don't get me wrong" communication disclaimer
- [Piece of Heaven: Definition, Meaning, and Origin](https://usdictionary.com/idioms/piece-of-heaven): Idiom definition for "piece of heaven" expressing bliss
